text_en: Elihu continued and said:
text_cn: 厄里乌又接着说：

text_en: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you, for I have yet something to say on God’s behalf.
text_cn: 你且等一会，容我教导你，因为为天主，我还有些话要说。

text_en: I will bring my knowledge from far away, and ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
text_cn: 我要将我所知的传到远方，将正义归于我的造主。

text_en: For truly my words are not false; one who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
text_cn: 的确，我的话正确无伪，知识全备的人同你一起。

text_en: “Surely God is mighty and does not despise any; he is mighty in strength of understanding.
text_cn: 的确，天主宽宏大量，决不藐视任何人，并且有广大的同情心。

text_en: He does not keep the wicked alive, but gives the afflicted their right.
text_cn: 他决不容许恶人生存，但给穷苦人伸冤；

text_en: He does not withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
text_cn: 他也不剥夺义人的权利。他使君王永久坐在宝座上，但是他们却骄矜自大；

text_en: And if they are bound in fetters and caught in the cords of affliction,
text_cn: 故此，当他们一旦被锁链束缚，被痛苦的绳索所系，

text_en: then he declares to them their work and their transgressions, that they are behaving arrogantly.
text_cn: 天主就向他们指明他们的恶行，和他们所夸耀的过犯，

text_en: He opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
text_cn: 开启他们的耳朵，以听训戒，嘱咐他们离开邪恶。

text_en: If they listen, and serve him, they complete their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasantness.
text_cn: 如果他们服从顺命，便能幸福地度过岁月，能安乐地享受天年。

text_en: But if they do not listen, they shall perish by the sword, and die without knowledge.
text_cn: 如果不服从，必被射死，于不知不觉中逝去。

text_en: “The godless in heart cherish anger; they do not cry for help when he binds them.
text_cn: 心术败坏的人，愤怒填胸，纵被囚禁，仍不呼求救助；

text_en: They die in their youth, and their life ends in shame.
text_cn: 他们必早年夭折，丧命如男倡。

text_en: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear by adversity.
text_cn: 所以天主藉痛苦拯救受难的人，以患难开启他们的耳鼓。

text_en: He also allured you out of distress into a broad place where there was no constraint, and what was set on your table was full of fatness.
text_cn: 他也要救你摆脱灾难，领你到广阔自由之地，在你桌上常摆满肥馔（zhuàn）美味；

text_en: “But you are obsessed with the case of the wicked; judgment and justice seize you.
text_cn: 无如你判断与恶人完全一样，那么惩罚和判案必集于你身。

text_en: Beware that wrath does not entice you into scoffing, and do not let the greatness of the ransom turn you aside.
text_cn: 小心！不要让忿怒引你肆口谩骂，也不要为重罚让你离弃正道。

text_en: Will your cry avail to keep you from distress, or will all the force of your strength?
text_cn: 你的哀号和你所有的力量，岂能使你摆脱患难？

text_en: Do not long for the night, when peoples are cut off in their place.
text_cn: 不要希望黑夜，那是人民由本地被劫去的时候。

text_en: Beware! Do not turn to iniquity; because of that you have been tried by affliction.
text_cn: 小心！别倾向不义，因为这正是你遭难的真正原因。

text_en: See, God is exalted in his power; who is a teacher like him?
text_cn: 天主的能力确实伟大，那有像他那样的主宰？

text_en: Who has prescribed for him his way, or who can say, ‘You have done wrong’?
text_cn: 谁能规定他的道路，谁敢说：你行的不对？

text_en: “Remember to extol his work, of which mortals have sung.
text_cn: 你应记住要赞颂他的工程，这是人们应歌咏的。

text_en: All people have looked on it; everyone watches it from far away.
text_cn: 人人都能观赏，都能从远处仰望：

text_en: Surely God is great, and we do not know him; the number of his years is unsearchable.
text_cn: 天主何其伟大，我们不能理解！他的岁数，无法考究。

text_en: For he draws up the drops of water; he distills his mist in rain,
text_cn: 他汲收水滴，使水气化为雨露，

text_en: which the skies pour down and drop upon mortals abundantly.
text_cn: 雨即从云中倾盆而降，沛然落在众人身上。

text_en: Can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds, the thunderings of his pavilion?
text_cn: 但谁能明了云彩怎样散布，天幕中怎样发出隆隆之声？

text_en: See, he scatters his lightning around him and covers the roots of the sea.
text_cn: 他将云雾展开，遮盖了群山山顶。

text_en: For by these he governs peoples; he gives food in abundance.
text_cn: 他借此养育万民，赐给他们丰富的食粮。

text_en: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
text_cn: 他掌中握着电光，对准目标发射出去。

text_en: Its crashing tells about him; he is jealous with anger against iniquity.
text_cn: 雷霆报告他的来临，他的怒火将要惩罚邪恶。
